commands.cmd:
set -u
T=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
STABLE="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promptfoo-0.123.1"
if [ -x "$STABLE/node_modules/.bin/promptfoo" ]; then
  PF_BIN="$STABLE/node_modules/.bin/promptfoo"
  echo "promptfoo source: existing stable install"
else
  timeout 180 npm install --prefix "$T/promptfoo" promptfoo@0.123.1 --no-audit --no-fund >"$T/npm-install.log" 2>&1
  NPM_RC=$?
  if [ "$NPM_RC" -ne 0 ]; then echo "npm install failed rc=$NPM_RC"; tail -20 "$T/npm-install.log"; exit 1; fi
  PF_BIN="$T/promptfoo/node_modules/.bin/promptfoo"
  echo "promptfoo source: ephemeral npm install (no stable install found)"
fi
test -x "$PF_BIN" || { echo "promptfoo binary missing at $PF_BIN"; exit 1; }
PF_VERSION=$(PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 timeout 20 "$PF_BIN" --version)
echo "promptfoo --version: $PF_VERSION"
if [ "$PF_VERSION" != "0.123.1" ]; then echo "version mismatch: got $PF_VERSION"; exit 1; fi

cat > "$T/promptfooconfig.yaml" <<'YAMLCFG'
description: "native-agent-stack promptfoo use receipt: local llama.cpp Qwen3.8-27B eval"
providers:
  - id: openai:chat:qwen3.8-27b-local
    config:
      apiBaseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:18232/v1
      apiKeyEnvar: PF_LLAMA_KEY
      temperature: 0
      max_tokens: 32
      passthrough:
        chat_template_kwargs:
          enable_thinking: false
prompts:
  - "{{query}}"
tests:
  - vars: { query: "What is 2+2? Reply with only the digit, nothing else." }
    assert:
      - type: equals
        value: "4"
  - vars: { query: "Name the capital of France. Reply with just the city name, nothing else." }
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Paris"
  - vars: { query: "Is 7 a prime number? Reply with only yes or no." }
    assert:
      - type: javascript
        value: "/\\byes\\b/i.test(output)"
  - vars: { query: "Reply with exactly the single word: PONG" }
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "PONG"
  - description: "positive control: deliberately wrong assertion, must fail"
    vars: { query: "Reply with exactly the single word: PONG" }
    assert:
      - type: equals
        value: "DEFINITELY_WRONG_TOKEN_never_matches"
YAMLCFG

PF_KEYFILE=$(timeout 10 systemctl --user cat nativestack-generation.service | grep -oP -- '--api-key-file\s+\K\S+')
if [ -z "$PF_KEYFILE" ]; then echo "could not parse --api-key-file from nativestack-generation.service"; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -r "$PF_KEYFILE" ]; then echo "parsed key file is not readable"; exit 1; fi
IFS= read -r PF_LLAMA_KEY < "$PF_KEYFILE"
export PF_LLAMA_KEY

set +e
PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="$T/pf-home" PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 \
  timeout 180 "$PF_BIN" eval -c "$T/promptfooconfig.yaml" -o "$T/results.json" -j 1 --no-table --no-progress-bar --no-share >"$T/stdout.log" 2>"$T/stderr.log"
EVAL_RC=$?
set -e
unset PF_LLAMA_KEY

python3 - "$T/results.json" "$EVAL_RC" <<'PYCHK'
import json, sys
path, eval_rc = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])
d = json.load(open(path))
stats = d["results"]["stats"]
rows = d["results"]["results"]
outputs = [r.get("response", {}).get("output") for r in rows]
passes = [bool(r.get("success")) for r in rows]
expected_pass = [True, True, True, True, False]
expected_outputs = ["4", "Paris", "yes", "PONG", "PONG"]
provider_ids = {r.get("provider", {}).get("id") for r in rows}
live_requests = stats.get("incurredTokenUsage", stats["tokenUsage"])["numRequests"]
ok = (
    eval_rc == 100
    and stats["successes"] == 4
    and stats["failures"] == 1
    and stats["errors"] == 0
    and 4 <= live_requests <= 5
    and passes == expected_pass
    and outputs == expected_outputs
    and provider_ids == {"openai:chat:qwen3.8-27b-local"}
)
print(
    f"promptfoo eval exit={eval_rc} | successes={stats['successes']} failures={stats['failures']} "
    f"errors={stats['errors']} | live_model_requests={live_requests} | "
    f"outputs={outputs} | per_row_pass={passes} | positive_control_caught={passes[4] is False}"
)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYCHK

reviews.ref: Reproduce: re-ran only the local part of cmd0 (stack and winner pins 0.123.1); did not re-run cmd0's npm view (network) or cmd1 (installs from npm and calls the loopback model server). Adequacy-checked: (1) layer role passes (a 5-case promptfoo eval runs against the local model, 5 live requests); (2) positive control passes (a deliberately wrong assertion is reported as a failure and promptfoo exits 100); (4) passes (component_id promptfoo is the quality-evaluation winner, tool_versions 0.123.1, pin_matches True). MISSING POINT 3 (backed claims): the claim says the loopback server 'serves the qualified Qwen3.8-27B GGUF' (llama.cpp), but no retained command or output reads the served model; the provider id qwen3.8-27b-local is a client-side label. I confirmed out-of-band that the generation unit is configured with that model file and alias, so the sentence is probably true but unbacked. Fix: retain a command that prints the server's model and back or drop 'qualified'.
